messages:
incident-bot: [31mALERT[0m KB: kv-cache spill rate > 12% + batch-scheduler tail p95 > 2000ms on prod-cluster-3. Alert id: kb-9981.

alice_sre: acknowledging. starting incident thread.

diego_oncall: I'm on-call. quick snapshot: small-chat requests timing out, a few 502s, KV eviction rate spiked ~3x over baseline. attaching quick logs.

ben_runtime: FYI we deployed continuous-batching 1.10.0 yesterday evening with a scheduler packing tweak. Could be the trigger.

caren_ml: seeing traffic mix shift: more long-context completion workloads started at 01:50UTC, concurrent with post-deploy. Short requests queue length is high.

alice_sre: recent logs:
```
[2026-03-15T03:05:12Z] kv_cache: mem_usage=86% evict_rate=5/s prefetch_rate=1.4
[2026-03-15T03:05:13Z] scheduler: pending_short=140 pack_fill_ms=1100 greedy=true
[2026-03-15T03:05:14Z] http: 502_count=18/5m short_req_p95=2100ms
```

maya_prodeng: customer impact check pls.

priya_support: preliminary: 4 Dedicated customers reporting elevated latency; two have opened formal incidents (P1). Search and chat features affected for them.

diego_oncall: mitigation plan options: A) immediate throttle prefetch + reduce pack_default B) add pack_priority for short requests C) rollback scheduler change. Thoughts?

ben_runtime: fastest low-risk: reduce pack_default from 24 -> 6 and set short_request_max_pack=2. Also add KV_PREFETCH_LIMIT=0.6. These are config flips, no binary rollback yet.

alice_sre: ops-runbook-bot, stage config hotpatch and notify for canary rollout.

ops-runbook-bot: runbook task created by alice_sre. Steps: (1) setenv PACK_DEFAULT=6 (2) patch config batch-scheduler-hotfix-9981.yaml (3) set KV_PREFETCH_FACTOR=0.6. Confirm to run canary.

diego_oncall: launching 10% canary on prod-cluster-3.

ben_runtime: patch commands run:
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap batch-scheduler --patch '{"data":{"pack_default":"6","short_request_max_pack":"2"}}'
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/inference-service KV_PREFETCH_FACTOR=0.6
```

caren_ml: dashboards: short_request_queue fell from 140 -> 12 on canary. KV eviction down ~55%. p95 short calls down 2.1s -> 380ms.

alice_sre: good. expand to 50% after 5m observation.

ben_runtime: rolled to 50%. overall cluster p95 improved. no significant CPU pressure yet.

maya_prodeng: customer comms: Priya, send an interim note explaining mitigation and ETA for full fix.

priya_support: note sent: "We applied a mitigation that should improve short-request latency; monitoring and will follow up with a post-incident summary."

diego_oncall: observation: a small set of long tasks show higher cost due to smaller packs. acceptable tradeoff given customer impact.

alice_sre: root cause hypothesis: scheduler's greedy pack_fill now groups long-running completions with short calls; long requests hold packs and generate bursts of KV prefetch for their context, causing cache thrash and eviction storms.

ben_runtime: confirmed in PR #4452: a change removed the fastpath that prioritized short calls and made pack_fill greedy regardless of request signature. We'll prepare a revert/targeted fix to reintroduce short_request_fastpath and admission control.

diego_oncall: action items: keep hot-config until code fix merged. Add alarm for short_request_waiters > 100 or kv_evict_rate > 4/s.

alice_sre: ops-runbook update: add a step to toggle PACK_DEFAULT via configmap for emergency rollback.

ops-runbook-bot: hotpatch completed to 100% (patch id hotfix-1990001111-01).

priya_support: update to customers: mitigation deployed cluster-wide; please let us know if you still see issues.

alice_sre: metrics t+12m: p95 short 0.45s, cluster-wide 502s at baseline, KV mem stable. Marking incident mitigated.

maya_prodeng: who owns the follow-up?

ben_runtime: I'll own the code-level fix and the revert PR for scheduler admission. caren_ml to add mixed-workload regression tests. alice_sre to own alarms/runbook updates.

caren_ml: will add a synthetic CI workload for mixed ratios (short 32 tokens @70%, long 4096 @30%) and add fairness assertions.

diego_oncall: leaving on-call; handing to alice_sre for monitoring window.

alice_sre: taking handoff. scheduling postmortem and timeline.

priya_support: setting customer tickets to pending-followup.

alice_sre: incident resolved. Followups: (1) revert greedy pack fill / reintroduce fastpath (owner: ben_runtime) (2) add pack fairness alarms and runbook toggles (owner: alice_sre) (3) KV prefetch hysteresis and rate limit (owner: ben_runtime) (4) CI mixed-workload tests (owner: caren_ml).

ben_runtime: note for postmortem: include exact reproduction steps, traffic mix, the diff in PR #4452, and cost/latency tradeoffs from hotfix.

incident-bot: Incident kb-9981 marked MITIGATED by alice_sre at 1990001400. Postmortem requested.

alice_sre: thanks all, closing thread for now.
